title: Every model call thinks at effort xhigh and keeps its summary, the measured roles' calls too
request: The owner: store the thinking summary of every call; the extra cost of effort xhigh is no problem.
spec: CLAUDE.md rule 8 and the owner's rule of 2026-10-28: every model call keeps its API thinking summary (thinking on, display summarized), never reasoning asked for in the reply.
plan: Find every call that does not think
Make the roles think within their cap

decisions.why: adaptive thinking returned a summary on 0 of 3 short calls at the default, medium and high effort, and on 3 of 3 at xhigh, at about 2.5 times a call's cost

decisions.decision: The twin's measured roles think too
decisions.why: they answered without thinking to match how they were measured; the owner now wants every call's thinking, so their next runs may score differently

decisions.decision: The roles' per-call cap rises from EUR 0.05 to EUR 0.20
decisions.why: the estimate counts the thinking's room, so a thinking role call was refused before it was sent under EUR 0.05

decisions.decision: No test at effort max from now on
decisions.why: the owner, 2026-10-29: too costly; max kept 96% of summaries against 87% at xhigh but replied in about 29 s instead of 5

change: dclab_rnd/roles.py (CALL_CAP_EUR), dclab_rnd/twin/claude.py (the roles' thinking), .env.example (the measured effort levels), tests/test_twin_runs.py.

findings.defect: Most calls kept no thinking summary although thinking was asked
findings.scenario: 2026-10-29: 1 of 8 home_intent calls, 137 of 1191 home_agent turns and 1 of 95 writer calls returned a summary.
findings.cause: Adaptive thinking chooses not to think on short tasks below effort xhigh; asking for display summarized is not enough.
findings.fix: The workspace asks for effort xhigh; a probe returned a summary on 3 of 3 calls.

findings.defect: A thinking role call would be refused by its own call cap
findings.scenario: A measured role with thinking on and a EUR 0.05 cap.
findings.cause: The cost estimate includes the thinking's room; EUR 0.05 cannot hold it.
findings.fix: The cap is EUR 0.20 and the roles think.

measurements.name: Thinking summaries by effort, three short home_intent calls
measurements.result: 0 of 3 at default, medium and high; 3 of 3 at xhigh (EUR 0.016) and max (EUR 0.065)

measurements.name: Sonnet 5.5 at effort max against xhigh, Home dev (stopped early by the owner: too costly)
measurements.gate: thinking summaries kept and reply seconds
measurements.result: home_agent: max 25 of 26 calls with a summary (96%), median 28.5 s, p90 67.9 s, EUR 0.048 a call; xhigh 79 of 91 (87%), median 5.2 s, p90 8.8 s, EUR 0.007 a call

measurements.name: Opus 5.5 at effort high, 10 English dev cases (HOME-022), against Sonnet 5.5 at xhigh on the same cases (HOME-018)
measurements.gate: the same scores; thinking kept; seconds; cost
measurements.result: the same quality on these 10: the kind of help 9 of 10, fields 19 right / 1 wrong / 1 missed, traps 3 of 3, no uncited number, for both. Opus: home_intent 11 of 11 with a summary, median 7.3 s (Sonnet 11.0 s), EUR 0.013 a call (0.012); home_agent 21 of 23 (91%; Sonnet 87%), median 4.4 s (5.2 s), EUR 0.011 a call (0.007). The run cost EUR 0.40. Ten cases, and Sonnet's run came before two wording fixes: small and not quite level.

measurements.name: Opus 5.5 at high (HOME-023) against Sonnet 5.5 at xhigh (HOME-024): all 36 Home dev cases, same code, run side by side
measurements.gate: the same scores; thinking kept; seconds; cost
measurements.result: quality level: the kind of help Opus 32 of 36 (English 21 of 24), Sonnet 33 (23 of 24); fields 72 right for both (2 against 3 wrong); traps Opus 5 of 6, Sonnet 6 of 6; no uncited number either way. Thinking kept: Opus 37 of 37 intent and 78 of 85 conversation calls (92%), Sonnet 38 of 38 and 70 of 82 (85%). Seconds: intent median 9.4 against 10.3 (slowest tenth 11.7 against 29.8), conversation 4.8 against 4.9. Cost: EUR 1.55 against 0.99 for the run (about 1.6 times).

outcome: Every call thinks at xhigh and keeps its summary. Opus 5.5 at high matches Sonnet 5.5 at xhigh on Home's dev set, keeps a little more thinking (92% against 85%) at about 1.6 times the cost; Sonnet stays the product's model.
lessons: Asking a model for its thinking's summary does not make it think: the effort level decides whether there is anything to summarise.
risks: Calls cost about 2.5 times more; the roles' scores were measured without thinking.
